learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will understand how Prepositions show the relationship between nouns/pronouns and other words, focusing on Place, Time, and Direction.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Where is the cat? Is it ON the table, UNDER the chair, or BEHIND the door? The tiny little words that tell us where things are, when things happen, or where they are going are called Prepositions! 🗺️

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A Preposition is a word placed before a noun or pronoun to show its relationship with another word in the sentence. They help us understand position, time, and direction.
examples_or_templates: The book is ON the desk.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: These prepositions tell us WHERE something is located. Common examples include: in, on, at, under, above, between, among, beside, and behind.
examples_or_templates: The apple is IN the basket.
He sat BETWEEN his two friends.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Time prepositions tell us WHEN something happens (e.g., at 5 o'clock, on Monday, in December). Direction prepositions tell us WHERE something is moving (e.g., to the park, into the room, towards the gate).
examples_or_templates: Time: The match starts AT 6 PM.
Direction: The frog jumped INTO the pond.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which preposition correctly completes the sentence? 'My birthday is ___ October.'
❓ Identify the preposition of direction in this sentence: 'The students walked towards the playground.'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blanks with the correct prepositions: 'The cat jumped ______ the wall and hid ______ the bush.'
subjective_practice.hint: Use a direction word for the wall, and a place word for the bush.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Correct the mistake in this sentence: 'I will meet you in Monday.'
subjective_practice.hint: We use a different preposition for days of the week.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Underline all the prepositions: 'The keys are on the table, next to the lamp.'
subjective_practice.hint: There are two phrases here telling you where the keys are.

activity_or_assignment.title: 👀 I Spy with Prepositions
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Look around your room and write 3 sentences describing exactly where your favorite toy, book, or gadget is located. You MUST use at least two prepositions of place in each sentence!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Prepositions show the relationship between nouns/pronouns and other words.
⭐ They often describe Place (in, on, under) and Direction (to, into, towards).
⭐ Prepositions of Time include 'at' for clock times, 'on' for days, and 'in' for months.
